subject.title: [Bug]: Fallback model does not report progress correctly during long tasks

question: Should OpenClaw guarantee channel-visible intermediate progress parity across model fallback candidates, including cross-provider fallback attempts with different streaming and tool-progress behavior?
rationale: The code has several progress surfaces and related fallback delivery work, so maintainers need to set the shared progress contract before an automated repair risks adding a narrow provider-specific workaround.

options.title: Guarantee parity in core
options.body: Treat fallback attempts as the same user-visible progress contract as primary attempts and fix the shared progress plumbing plus tests.

options.title: Document provider gaps
options.body: Guarantee only diagnostic or typing progress where a fallback provider lacks streaming/tool-progress capability and document the degraded mode.

options.title: Fold into fallback delivery work
options.body: Track this under the broader durable fallback delivery contract if maintainers want one channel semantics project to own all fallback visibility behavior.

recommendation.title: Guarantee parity in core
recommendation.body: Treat fallback attempts as the same user-visible progress contract as primary attempts and fix the shared progress plumbing plus tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The model fallback mechanism appears to originate in his fallback introduction commit, and the decision is about the fallback contract rather than a single channel adapter.
